name: so101
title: SO-101 follower arm (TheRobotStudio SO-ARM100 / Hugging Face LeRobot)
license: Apache-2.0 (hardware and software). Files in this folder are unmodified copies from Simulation/SO101.

steps.title: Base: shoulder-pan servo (ID 1) and controller plate
steps.instructions: Press the ID 1 servo into the base motor holder, screw the holder into the base with M2 self-tappers, then fit the Waveshare/Seeed mounting plate on the back of the base and clip the bus servo board onto it.

steps.title: Shoulder: rotation-pitch bracket and shoulder-lift servo (ID 2)
steps.instructions: Mount the rotation-pitch bracket on the ID 1 horn (4 screws through the horn), seat the ID 2 servo in its holder and close the holder.

steps.title: Upper arm and elbow servo (ID 3)
steps.instructions: Fit the ID 3 servo into the upper arm, then attach the upper arm to the ID 2 horn and idler.

steps.title: Forearm and wrist-flex servo (ID 4)
steps.instructions: Mount the forearm on the ID 3 horn, slide the ID 4 servo into the wrist motor holder and screw the holder to the forearm.

steps.title: Wrist roll (ID 5)
steps.instructions: Attach the wrist-roll-pitch part to the ID 4 horn and seat the ID 5 servo (no horn) inside it.

steps.title: Gripper: fixed jaw, gripper servo (ID 6) and moving jaw
steps.instructions: Mount the fixed jaw on the ID 5 horn, install the ID 6 servo in the fixed jaw, and screw the moving jaw onto the ID 6 horn with the gripper closed.
